title: Mastery only for verified learning
statement: Award mastery, progress and rewards only for verified learning: passive activity, clicking through, revealed answers, guessing, replays and low-accuracy work earn nothing, and detected gaming costs points.
example: A walkthrough that clicked through without reading earned a mastery stamp at about 20 percent accuracy.
detail: In a hands-on walkthrough of a Grade 3 course, a course review earned a mastery stamp at about 20 percent accuracy by clicking through without reading, then advanced with the passage hidden (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5_build_2026_07_02/feedback_clean.md`). An AP course package lists XP only for verified learning among its rules: candidate items, time, reading, voice, navigation in review mode and answer reveal award 0 XP, and its preview awards no mastery while the contract requires 90 percent verified mastery (`grade3-reading/edullm-review-hub/course-packages/courses/apush/review/evidence/incept-acceptance.json`). The package records the XP rule as passing in preview, with runtime unverified.
against: On points the sources differ: a Grade 5 release computes preview XP from whole focused minutes at one XP per minute, though only at a successful finish that meets a 90 percent checkpoint (`grade3-reading/edullm-review-hub/docs/G5_STUDENT_EXPERIENCE_RELEASE_GATE.qmd`; `grade3-reading/artifacts/wiki-research/hub-review-model.md`), where the AP package gives time 0 XP.
